summary: VeriSign filed an 8-K to report the completion of a $550 million registered offering of 5.100% Senior Notes due 2031 under its existing shelf registration. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other senior debt, issued under a base indenture supplemented by a third supplemental indenture. Interest is payable semi-annually, with make-whole redemption provisions and a change-of-control put at 101%. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation characteristics.
